lede: Pali And Burmese accounts for 11 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (100% of the corpus for this language). Nearly all (100%) are written in Burmese · อักษรพม่า script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (73%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (27%). Dated witnesses run 1897–1916 CE (2 of 11 carry a date).
